entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 18 (version 4, 32% built): welding a custom springy hull washer onto the Little Dart's secondary exhaust flange (using Tok, a strip of hull plating) (used Tilly, a scorched heat tile)
welding a fresh titanium washer into the Little Dart's secondary fuel line
entries.why: my craft meter is itching and the Little Dart needs more armor before her next hop.
entries.detail: welding a custom springy hull washer onto the Little Dart's secondary exhaust flange (using Tok, a strip of hull plating)

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Back to the Little Dart"
Put Rusty Jr (a cracked navigation chip), Sprocket (a scorched heat tile), Tok (a strip of hull plating), Mabel (a coil of copper wire) on his shelf.
plugged into the charging dock, brass dish resting quietly against the bulkhead
entries.why: my battery is getting low and my joints need a quick recharge before I get back to building

entries.text: Spotted a cracked navigation chip half-buried in the sand. Named it Rusty Jr.
sitting on the dune ridge, letting the brass dish catch the quiet static of deep space
entries.why: staring at the hazy stars helps my optical sensors cool down after a long stretch of wire searching.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "night wind on the dune ridge"
